import sys

def decompose(B, value, base, index):
    if index == 100:
        return
    B[index] = value % base
    decompose(B, value // base, base, index + 1)

def carry(B, base, index):
    if index == 100:
        return
    if B[index] > 1:
        B[index] -= base
        B[index + 1] += 1
    carry(B, base, index + 1)

def is_possible(B):
    for i in range(101):
        if B[i] < -1 or B[i] > 1:
            return False
    return True

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    W = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    B = [0] * 101
    decompose(B, M, W, 0)
    carry(B, W, 0)
    if is_possible(B):
        print("YES")
    else:
        print("NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
